text:
Nina (PM): 10-min sync: customers want a lightweight console view linking cost spikes to traces/errors. need to decide MVP.
Ravi (Eng): propose minimal: cost heatmap + trace-link button that fetches a sampled span. low infra impact.
Tess (SRE): must include runtime throttles. default sample 0.2% and per-route caps.
Marta (CS): top customers need per-call op_id in CSV for support — high impact for renewals.
Nina (PM): MVP bullets: heatmap (24h/7d), trace-link for sampled spans, CSV export for canary customers, error tags on heatmap.
Ravi (Eng): tech notes: need X-Op-Id header and an event join key. estimate: 2 devs x 2 weeks + 3 days infra.
Tess (SRE): rollout: internal -> 2 partners -> wider. add alert: trace-ingest > 3000 spans/min.
Marta (CS): can we ship CSV first as a quick win? customers will love it.
Nina (PM): agree: prioritize CSV + heatmap for canary, follow with trace UI. acceptance: heatmap <2s p95, CSV contains op_id, sampling obeyed.
Ravi (Eng): will post final estimates by EOD.
